info.name: Anchorage Digital API Reference Addresses Tagging API

params.name: type
params.description: Filter tags by ownership type (system, backoffice, client)

params.name: entityId
params.description: Return tags applied to this entity ID

items.docs: List tags filtered by ownership type and/or entity. When entityId is provided, returns tags applied to that entity. When type is provided, filters tag definitions by ownership type.
Create a new tag. Tags are also auto-created on first use via POST /v2/tags/apply, so explicit creation is optional.
Apply one or more tags to an entity. Tags are auto-created if they do not exist.

info.name: Remove a tag from an entity

params.name: entityId
params.description: The entity ID to remove the tag from

params.name: tagName
params.description: The name of the tag to remove (case-insensitive)

items.docs: Remove a specific tag from an entity. Tag name matching is case-insensitive.

params.name: name
params.description: Comma-separated list of tag names to search by

params.name: type
params.description: Filter results by entity type (e.g. withdrawal, transfer)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination (entity_id of last seen result)

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100)

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order by tag application time

items.docs: Search for entities that have specific tags applied. Supports cursor-based pagination.
